name: Texasetes
isnote: Arbour et al. 2016 placed Texasetes closer to Edmontonia, while Pawpawsaurus fell near Europelta; the two may be synonyms (cited revision).
sum: Texasetes is a poorly known nodosaurid from the Albian Paw Paw Formation of Texas, perhaps a senior synonym of Pawpawsaurus.
holotype: USNM 337987, with a skull fragment, teeth, vertebral centra, limb bones and osteoderms — Paw Paw Formation, Haslet, Tarrant County, Texas.
biology: Little is known directly because the remains are fragmentary; little dorsal armour or ribs are preserved.
author: Coombs 1995
